description: This source file defines the AnthropicPassthroughLoggingHandler class, which manages logging, response transformation, and batch handling for Anthropic LLM passthrough endpoints within a larger machine learning or API framework. It includes methods for response processing, chunk splitting, batch creation and tracking, and integration with a proxy logging system.
